note: J_ax(v) is the product of the chart's Haar density J over the free links at the axial point rho u; `treasury` identifies it with |det Ds|.

def thermal (F : Forest S.ratio) (t : S.Choices) (p : Clip) (R : PathData G)
    (ρ : fieldDir G c 1 → AxisChart G F) (A : ChartRatio G) (u : fieldDir G c 1) : ℝ :=
    loop R (lifting F (represent u) (ρ u)) + (1/2) * Real.log (hessian F t p R u (ρ u)).det -
        Real.log (∏ i : F.Free, A.J (ρ u i))

proof_context.conclusion: `thermal` equals `loop R (lifting ..)` + (1/2) log det (`hessian` F t p R u (rho u)) - log (prod_i `A.J` (rho u i)), the loop action at U_v, half the log determinant of Q(v), and minus the log of the Haar density J_ax.
